#.label: Gift card routing (preview)
#/properties/id.label: Entry name
#/properties/id.description: A name for this entry, for example “Retain24”. Must be unique on this page.
#/properties/prefixLow.label: Card numbers from
#/properties/prefixLow.description: The first digits of the lowest card number in the range, for example 600649.
#/properties/prefixHigh.label: Card numbers to
#/properties/prefixHigh.description: The first digits of the highest card number in the range. Use the same digits as “from” for a single prefix.
#/properties/panLength.label: Card number length
#/properties/panLength.description: The total number of digits on the card, for example 16.
Gift cards are recognised by the first d: Gift cards are recognised by the first digits of the card number and by its length. Each entry sends the cards it covers to one gift card provider.
#/properties/connector.label: Gift card provider
#/properties/connector.description: The provider that handles gift cards in the ranges below. NONE means these cards are not handled by Hii Connect.
Make sure ranges do not overlap, within: Make sure ranges do not overlap, within an entry or between entries. The portal does not check this, and an overlap can send a card to the wrong provider.
#/properties/ranges.label: Card number ranges
#/properties/ranges.description: The card numbers this provider handles.
